name: fixly-vscode
description: Real-time remediation for npm dependencies — detects new vulnerabilities the moment they land, fixes package.json, installs, and verifies. Powered by OSV.

fixly.scanOnSave.description: Automatically rescan when package.json or package-lock.json changes on disk (editor saves, terminal installs, AI-agent writes).

fixly.autoRemediate.description: The remediation engine: when new vulnerabilities are detected, automatically rewrite package.json (undoable), run npm install, and verify with a re-scan. Turn off for a Fix & Verify prompt instead. Findings that already existed when the project was opened are never auto-fixed.

fixly.advisoryIntervalMinutes.description: Re-scan on an interval so newly published advisories surface (and are remediated) without any local file change. 0 disables. Takes effect on reload.

fixly.includeTransitive.description: Also scan transitive dependencies discovered in the package-lock.json tree.
